why: Seed ASCII-art blocks that stay until OPS-97 migrates them to ```diagram blocks. Each entry permits one fenced block: its slug and the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the block's info string, a newline and its body. bin/wiki lint --seed reports a matched block as a warning. Any other ASCII art in the article is an error, and so is a changed pinned block. An entry that matches no block is inert: it permits nothing and lint warns about it. tools/wiki/tests/diagram.test.ts pins the original entries, so this list only shrinks.
